name: IaC-Eval
description: IaC-Eval is a code generation benchmark for Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) programs, focusing on cloud infrastructure development using AWS services. It includes 458 human-curated scenarios with natural language problem descriptions and infrastructure intent specifications to evaluate LLMs' ability to generate correct IaC code.
reputation: A recent code-generation benchmark for Infrastructure-as-Code that is still emerging, with limited but growing use in LLM evaluation for cloud automation.
notes: Highlights the difficulty of IaC code generation for LLMs compared to general Python code generation benchmarks.
